title: Printer
summary: PRINT'ER, noun One that prints books, pamphlets or papers. 1. One that stains or prints cloth with figures, as calico. 2. One that impresses letters or figures with copper-plates.

inlines.v: PRINT'ER, noun One that prints books, pamphlets or papers. 1. One that stains or prints cloth with figures, as calico. 2. One that impresses letters or figures with copper-plates.
